description: This file defines the SkewedClockConfigurator class which implements ISiloConfigurator to configure a skewed clock service within Orleans silo hosting, setting up a singleton IClock with skew parameters.

classes.name: SkewedClockConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up a skewed clock service in Orleans silo host.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to include a singleton IClock service with skew parameters.
